proposals.tactic:
have hn : n - 2 + 2 = n := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)
have he : n - 1 = n - 2 + 1 := by omega
have hb := factorial_bound (n - 2) n (le_of_eq hn)
rw [hn] at hb
refine lt_of_le_of_lt hb ?_
rw [he, pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm (n ^ (n - 2)) n]
have hn_pos : 0 < n := by omega
exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (show 2 < n by omega) (pow_pos hn_pos _)

have htwo : 2 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 2 < 3) h₀
have hn : n - 2 + 2 = n := Nat.sub_add_cancel (le_of_lt htwo)
have hb := factorial_bound (n - 2) n (le_of_eq hn)
rw [hn] at hb
have hpos : 0 < n := lt_trans (by decide : 0 < 2) htwo
calc
  n.factorial ≤ 2 * n ^ (n - 2) := hb
  _ < n * n ^ (n - 2) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right htwo (pow_pos hpos _)
  _ = n ^ (n - 2) * n := Nat.mul_comm _ _
  _ = n ^ (n - 1) := by
    have he : n - 1 = n - 2 + 1 := congrArg (fun a : Nat => a - 1) hn.symm
    rw [he, pow_succ]
